Results.ReviewText: Great grill! Owned exact same grill for 15 years, replacing burner, igniter, and flame arresters as needed. Quality product, cooks great!

Results.ReviewText: Oddly, my grill came with a badly damaged front door. It almost seemed impossible because the outer box was not damaged at all, but the door was seriously bent. I went on- line with Weber and they rectified the problem by sending a new door immediately. I received the new door in six days.

Results.ReviewText: We love our BBQ and it has served us well.  When we needed to replace some parts, we were very impressed with the service and didn't realize that the parts we needed were under warranty.  The representative we spoke with was extremely helpful and took good care of us.  We have had other Weber BBQs in the past and have always been pleased.  But this latest experience with your customer service department has made us life long customers.

Gas flared on the operator side so the hair was singed from my hand.  I took it back to the retailer and .... " Got the Spirit!"  Recently grilled Salmon for 6 and was complimented highly.

Results.ReviewText:
This was a replacement box for our grill which melted while cooking burgers.
A grill probably shouldn’t be made with materials they may melt while cooking burgers. 
Instead of replacing the grill which was less than 2 years old, they sent me a new box and expect me to repair it myself.
If we had not noticed the box melting it could have burned downed our home and then the insurance company would have expected reimbursement for the loss.
I didn’t think replacing the grill was too much to ask. This will be our last Weber product.
Results.Title: Grill Box Melted

Results.ReviewText: Great grill, just right size for two person household. Heat ups great and easy to use. Would highly recommend!
Results.Title: Will continue to use Weber

Results.ReviewText: Our last Weber Spirit E-210 grill lasted 6 or 7 years out in the elements on our deck. Obviously much better quality construction than others we had purchased in the past which needed replaced after only a few seasons. Has just the right features for 2 people--no kids or extended family or frequent entertaining. Only complaint is that the guts of pretty much all grills these days are disposable and meant to be replaced fairly regularly. None of them, even the higher end makes like Weber construct the burners-grates etc. out of materials that will last the lifetime of the grill so by the time you need a new one, the function of these parts is questionable at best and even borders on dangerous at times when lighting. So, short of keeping it in your living room, a cover will have to do and hope it lasts even longer this time. Either way, well worth the extra money.
Results.Title: So good we bought the identical model again

Results.ReviewText: The grill operates well. My only problem is the grates are too far apart and food, both vegetables and meats , fall through the grates. Chicken is floppy and the ends fall down into the grates.   Otherwise a very nice grill.
Results.Title: Nice grill

Results.ReviewText: High quality finish, Easy to clean and keep looking new (so far)
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: This is the perfect grill for two people or a small family or couple.
Results.Title: Perfect Size

Results.ReviewText: Great compact grill.  Plenty of surface space for grilling.  Hold a full rack of ribs plus room for chicken or burgers.  Had a larger version before and glad I switched to the smaller option. Also like that the cabinet below hides the propane tank.
Results.Title: Size is perfect!

Results.ReviewText: In recent years I opted for cheaper grills. Big mistake. This Spirit 250 is well made and cooks/barbecues so much better. Save yourself a lot of aggravation and buy the Weber!
Results.Title: Love this grill

Results.ReviewText:
This would have been my first Weber grill, and I was excited...but the way the tank had to be loaded into the cabinet and then lifted onto the hanging bracket was a no-go. And because the hole in the floor of the cabinet was so big, I couldn't just set the tank down without it instead sitting on the ground, thereby making the grill unmovable. So I ended up returning the whole thing.
The best design would be to be able to carry the tank to the bracket while in a standing position, enabling the user to use the bigger and stronger leg and upper back muscles to load the tank onto the hook. On the other model, the hook is on the outside of the unit, which is better, but the side table is still in the way and makes the process awkward and difficult. A side table that can swing UP and out of the way when loading the tank would be a game changer!
Results.Title: Reputation means nothing if I can't load the tank!

Results.ReviewText: Great product-no issues! Was easy to build/put together---a snap to use! Grills an awesome steak!
Results.Title: Great product!

Results.ReviewText: After our old Weber of 25 years went to junkyard heaven, it was a no brainer to get another Weber. I did a lot of research but I ended up a bit disappointed on this selection and thought something was actually wrong with this grill. There are 3 burner covers yet gas only runs down the sides. So you have to grill your food on the right or the left and not in the middle. It is truly the most ridiculous set up I have run across. If I could have taken this back, I would have. Other than that, I have been pleased but that was a pretty big disappointment factor to grilling enjoyment.
Results.Title: A bit of a design flaw

Results.ReviewText: I really like the easy way to clean the grill you just pull out the tray and it’s done. I do not like the fuel gauge on the grill 1st time I have ever seen this option I think it’s a waste of money and time. That is the only complaint I have about the Weber Grill. Ps going to do bacon wrapped filets for Thanksgiving.
Results.Title: First Weber

Results.ReviewText: I have owned Weber products in the past (Black charcoal kettle grill) and been very impressed by Weber's product quality, design, utility, and simplicity.  Finding myself in the market for a new propane grill and the fact that my wife and I are now empty nesters', and the fact that my daughter purchased the spirit E-210 for her own use and really likes it, we decided to give Weber another try.  I have only used it 3 times so far but it performs very well for what I need which is quick, direct grilling.  It has 2 burners so it doesn't get quite as hot as I am used to with a previous 3 burner grill but it cooks very well and for the money I am very pleased.  Again quality, craftsmanship, and simplicity are evident in this fine product.    Thank you Weber!
Results.Title: Another Winner from Weber

Results.ReviewText: I had a rusting problem with my bbq (it's several years old) that I, of course, was not happy about. Although rusting is a concern that needs to be addressed by Weber, I'm rating them with 5 stars due to great customer service in rectifying the problem. The replacement arrived promptly with the necessary screws, etc. I'm happy with that. Apart from this the bbq has been great.

Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
